title: Date signed · B2 — staff: candidate detail (a choice: option a or b)
subtitle: Opened from a Star candidate row (Testing → Star testing → event → candidate). The date the family signed must show with the signature — also after the drawing is deleted 90 days after testing (v0.635, as Color Belt, Black Belt and Prospects do). Two ways to show it; each drawn at PC, phone and 320, for a signature on file (Noah Chen) and a removed one (Morgan Hale). Amber = the row today; green = what changes. Tablet is left out: there the detail is the same centred dialog as on PC and looks the same.

items.caption: PC 1280×800 · signature on file. “Ticked and signed · View signature” — no date.
PC 1280×800 · signature removed (90 days after testing). “Ticked and signed · signature removed Oct 31, 2026 (deleted 90 days after the testing day)” — the date signed is gone.

row.caption: 320 wide, touch. Already wraps, leaving “·” at the end of line 1.

items.caption: “View signature” — no change in either option. It already says “Signed Sat, Oct 31, 2026, 1:19 PM on the family form, after ticking the acknowledgment.”

columns.label: Option (a) — recommended

items.caption: PC 1280×800 · signature on file. New row “Date signed · Sat, Oct 31, 2026” under Acknowledgment, which stays “Ticked and signed · View signature”.
PC 1280×800 · signature removed (90 days after testing). The Date signed row stays; Acknowledgment keeps its “signature removed …” text.

columns.note: Pros: copies Prospects’ approved “Date signed” row and the family form’s box word for word; the date has the weekday like the Registered row; the Acknowledgment line doesn’t change or wrap more than today. Cons: one more row in the dialog.

columns.label: Option (b)

items.caption: PC 1280×800 · signature on file. “Ticked and signed Sat, Oct 31, 2026” then “· View signature” kept together on line 2.
PC 1280×800 · signature removed (90 days after testing). “Ticked and signed Sat, Jul 4, 2026 · signature removed Oct 31, 2026 (…)”: three lines.

columns.note: Pros: no new row; the date sits right next to the signature it belongs to. Cons: the line wraps at every size (2 lines with the link, 3 when removed), and two dates sit in one line in the removed state, which is harder to read.

footer: Rulebook v0.638 (Jeffrey, 2026-11-04): every family form shows “Date signed” under the signature, filled in automatically with the day the form is sent, gray, can’t be changed; wherever staff see a signature, its date signed shows with it. Preview screenshots (fake database, today = Fri, Nov 6, 2026). The “After” column is drawn over the real page by a small script (mock-dates.js) — nothing in the app was changed. No database change: the day the form is sent is already saved (star_candidate_signatures.signed_at). For a family-form registration the date signed is the same day as “Registered” (the signature is saved when the form is sent) — by design; v0.638 still asks for it.
